findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Template injection patterns in FastAPI
 * @description Checking for template rendering with potentially unsafe patterns
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/template-injection-patterns
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from API::CallNode call
where
  // Jinja2 Template constructor
  call = API::moduleImport("jinja2").getMember("Template").getACall() or
  // Jinja2 Environment constructor
  call = API::moduleImport("jinja2").getMember("Environment").getACall() or
  // FastAPI Jinja2Templates constructor
  call = API::moduleImport("fastapi").getMember("templating").getMember("Jinja2Templates").getACall() or
  // Template.render() calls
  call = API::moduleImport("jinja2").getMember("Template").getMember("render").getACall() or
  // Environment.get_template() calls
  call = API::moduleImport("jinja2").getMember("Environment").getMember("get_template").getACall()
select call, "Potential template injection point. Ensure user input is properly escaped before template rendering."
findings.hypothesis: Template injection vulnerability through Jinja2 template rendering
